event.name: AIGO AI Demo Night
event.description:
Join us for an AI demo night exploring the future of intelligent systems beyond traditional AI models. Discover how Cognitive AI focuses on reasoning, memory, learning, and adapting to real-world situations.

The event will feature Srini Pagidyala from Aigo.ai, who will showcase live demos and share how Aigo.ai is building the next generation of AI through adaptive intelligence.

Connect with AI builders, founders, and enthusiasts while exploring new ideas around the future of AI.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

sponsors.companyDescription: Aigo is a Cognitive AI platform focused on building adaptive, self-learning AI systems that go beyond traditional large language models. Instead of relying on massive datasets and probabilistic generation, Aigo emphasizes continuous learning, reasoning, memory, and contextual understanding to create intelligent assistants for enterprise applications

partners.companyDescription: Homebrew Club is a modern co-working space designed for founders, creators, freelancers, and professionals looking for a productive environment to work, collaborate, and build. It provides flexible workspaces, a vibrant community, and resources that help individuals and teams grow their ideas into successful ventures.
